topic: Design a nested-goal addon for system-spec-kit. A parent goal.md is the single objective an operator sets via the runtime goal command; it references per-phase child goal.md files so the effective directive can exceed whatever character cap the goal command enforces, while the set string stays small and stable. Investigate and decide: (1) how this should enter the Level contract in templates/spec-kit-docs.json — optionalAddonDocs vs lazyAddonDocs, which levels, phase-parent vs child semantics, and what a goal.md.tmpl should contain at each level; (2) the two runtime goal systems and how they differ — Claude Code's native goal is a session-scoped Stop hook holding a frozen condition string evaluated at stop time, while .opencode/plugins/opencode-goal.js is a local mimic that re-injects into the system prompt every turn via experimental.chat.system.transform and caps objective and prompt at 4000 chars in goal-core.cjs; the repo's own cli-claude-code playbook states the runtime-neutral goal core registers no Claude Code adapter; (3) the speckit command surface, which already carries ~96 goal mentions including a goal_prompting contract with goal_prompt_choice offer/skip/set that invokes the opencode_goal tool — a tool with no Claude adapter, so the existing offer does not fire in the runtime where native goal lives; decide whether that contract should become runtime-neutral and how; (4) the binding problem — nothing dereferences a path inside a goal string, so a parent-to-child reference is a prompt convention rather than a mechanism; determine what wording, precedence rule between parent decisions and child detail, and validation would make it reliable; (5) the stop-gate asymmetry — referenced child content reaches the working agent but not necessarily the stop evaluator, so completion criteria in the parent must stay self-contained and checkable, and evaluate whether the existing acceptance-criteria closure gate can serve as that packet-level check; (6) drift and staleness — a frozen condition set once diverges from a goal.md that keeps changing, as observed in packet 033 where the live condition still described two phases while goal.md had grown to 15028 characters across three; propose how goal.md should be split between durable directive and volatile log, and whether a validator should enforce a parent size cap.
